doc: stages/filters.georeference.rst is new at 2.6.0; its Options section lists `trajectory_file` -- 'path to a sbet trajectory file. [Mandatory]' -- `scan2imu`, '4x4 transformation matrix from scanner frame to body imu ... [Mandatory]', and `time_offset`, 'timestamp offset between trajectory and scanner GpsTime. [Default: 0]'. The stage is registered at 2.6.0, so `pdal --options filters.georeference` (apps/index.rst) reports its table on stdout; at 2.5.0 the stage does not exist and stdout is empty. Option NAMES only: no shipped page shows how `--options` renders a default, so the rendering is not graded.
